shortDescription: Global bond yields fell Thursday after the Federal Reserve’s rate increase and Chairman Kevin Warsh’s pledge to tame inflation, according to Bloomberg.Traders were also waiting for Friday’s Bank of Japan decision.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Global Bond Yields Ease After Warsh Inflation Remarks
